name: Baseball Bat
summary: Classic blunt-force melee weapon capable of silent incapacitation, shattering shop windows, and devastating close-range brawls.
description: A staple of the Grand Theft Auto franchise, the Baseball Bat returns in GTA VI with visceral impact physics, bone-cracking sound design, and custom street wrap modifications. Found behind sports shops, batting cages, and in vehicle trunks across Leonida.

seo.title: Baseball Bat: Melee Stats & Spawn Locations
seo.description: Find the Baseball Bat in GTA VI. Melee combat mechanics, trunk storage, takedown animations, and sports store locations.
